institution: Second Appeal to Central/State Information Commission (CIC/SIC)
addressee_block:
The Central Information Commission / State Information Commission
[Address of the CIC (New Delhi) or the relevant State Information Commission]
relevant_acts: Section 19(3) — Second Appeal to the Information Commission
Section 19(6) — time limit for disposal of appeals
Section 20 — penalties for unreasonable delay or denial
institution_rules: A Second Appeal lies to the Information Commission only after a First Appeal has been filed with the First Appellate Authority (FAA) and either (a) the FAA has decided against the appellant, or (b) the FAA has failed to decide within 45 days as required under Section 19(6). File the Second Appeal within 90 days of the FAA's order, or of the expiry of the 45-day period if the FAA did not respond — state and explain any delay beyond that. Reference the original RTI application date and reference number, the CPIO/SPIO's response (or non-response), the First Appeal date, and the FAA's order (or its absence). Request the Commission to direct disclosure of the information and to consider imposing a penalty under Section 20 for unreasonable delay or malafide denial. Attach copies of the original RTI application, the CPIO/SPIO's reply (if any), the First Appeal, and the FAA's order (if any). NEVER invent an appeal or complaint registration number. For offences and procedures after 1 July 2024, cite the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam (BSA) — NOT the repealed IPC 1860, CrPC 1973, or Indian Evidence Act 1872. The Prevention of Corruption Act 1988 and RTI Act 2005 remain in force and may be cited. If unsure of a new-code section number, use [VERIFY].
